verdict.rationale: Parsec's pricing page lists "Multi-monitor streaming (Up to 3)" and virtual monitors, so it has its own documented capability for streaming displays from a multi-display host. Nothing shows the user choosing a specific monitor or switching between monitors mid-session, and nothing covers window- or app-level viewing. The host app-approval control is a guest-permission feature, not a view-selection feature, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented selection of a specific monitor, mid-session switching between displays, per-window or per-app streaming, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session
